text: This report recommends that City Council refuse an application to demolish a heritage structure on the property at 421 Roncesvalles Avenue, which is designated by By-law No. 716-2017, enacted by City Council on August 23, 2017. The property at 421 Roncesvalles Avenue is designated under all three categories of cultural heritage value: design, associative and contextual. Under the Act, if City Council fails to make a decision on the application within 90 days of issuing a Notice of Receipt of the application, the application is deemed to be permitted under Section 34 of the Ontario Heritage Act. Based on issuance of the Notice of Receipt, the applicant must be notified of Council's decision by May 11, 2018.

The Toronto Preservation Board recommends to the Toronto and East York Community Council that: 1. City Council refuse the issuance of a demolition permit for the heritage property at 421 Roncesvalles Avenue, in accordance with Section 34 of the Ontario Heritage Act. 2. If the owner appeals City Council’s decision to refuse the issuance of a demolition permit under Section 34 of the Ontario Heritage Act for the heritage property at 421 Roncesvalles Avenue, City Council authorize the City Solicitor and the necessary City staff to attend the Ontario Municipal Board hearing in opposition to the appeal.
